module: Node "Get Navgraph Route" (once_instant). Computes a route on the navgraph between a start position and an end position. Inputs: posA, posB (vec3), legalRoute (hidden, true: respects traffic directions). Output: navgraphRoute (list of waypoints, type navgraphPath).
notes: The 4th argument of map.getPath is 1000 if legalRoute (penalty for forbidden directions) and 1 otherwise (inferred from code).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: For each position, finds the closest road (map.findClosestRoad) and keeps the closest node; if one fails, does nothing. Then computes map.getPath(start, end, nil, 1000 or 1) and writes it to the output.
